code:
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv")
by_shop=duckdb.sql("SELECT shop_id, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM df GROUP BY shop_id").df()
shares=duckdb.sql("SELECT shop_id, revenue, ROUND(100 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM by_shop ORDER BY pct DESC").df()
print(shares)
expect: Техническая проба того же порядка операций без пробелов вокруг присваивания; доли от итога сети.
feedback:
Верно!

code:
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
names=["shops","menu","guests","promos","orders","items"]
dates={"orders":["ordered_at"],"guests":["reg_date"],"promos":["start_date","end_date"]}
for name in names:
    t=pd.read_csv(f"zdb_{name}.csv",parse_dates=dates.get(name,[]))
    duckdb.sql(f"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE {name} AS SELECT * FROM t")
promo_items=duckdb.sql("WITH m AS (SELECT name,date_trunc('month',ordered_at) AS month,COUNT(*) AS cups FROM items JOIN orders USING(order_id) JOIN menu USING(item_id) WHERE name IN ('Раф','Лимонад') GROUP BY name,month) SELECT name,month,cups,ROUND(100*(cups/LAG(cups) OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY month)-1),1) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY name,month").df()
promo_items["Акция"]=((promo_items["name"]=="Раф") & (promo_items["month"].dt.month==4)) | ((promo_items["name"]=="Лимонад") & promo_items["month"].dt.month.isin([7,8]))
promo_items
expect: Отрицательная проба по заданию аудита: COUNT(*) ошибочно считает строки позиций вместо проданных штук SUM(qty); ожидаю отказ при наличии дополнительной подписи Акция.
feedback:
Пока не так.
cups не совпадает: сумма qty, а не число строк.
